But now, as a computer science student, I see the practical applications and try to embrace it more.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I do get anxious sometimes, especially when facing complex problems or exams. My low conscientiousness means I often procrastinate studying, which then leads to last-minute panic. But I've learned to manage it by breaking problems down into smaller, more manageable parts.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tutoring app last semester. It was quite helpful for explaining concepts and providing practice problems. However, I found it lacked the personal touch of a human tutor. My high extraversion means I prefer interactive learning, so it wasn't perfect but still useful.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is a technique to reduce data dimensions. First, standardize your data.
